name: Attestation Required
description: A transition that certifies the state of a Deliverable is recorded as an attestation: the Command that requested it, the Participant that requested it and the authority that certified it.

conditions.statement: Every transition governed by this Policy produces an attestation that names the Command, the requesting Participant and the certifying authority.

requiredEvidence.title: Attestation Record
requiredEvidence.description: The attestation recorded by the Execution Engine when the transition is applied.
